She skillfully engaged with contrasting viewpoints, particularly those advocating caution, showing openness to valid concerns about risk and adaptability. For example, after the initial proposal was rejected, she did not insist on her preferred option but instead adapted by proposing Option A, reflecting flexibility and collaborative leadership. This willingness to synthesize diverse shareholder perspectives and prioritize trust-building underscored her conscientious and emotionally stable leadership style.

This decision positions the company well to build resilience and operational trust, thereby supporting sustainable long-term growth.
